source.snippet: Is there any FOSS code, preferably PHP, but Python would be acceptable, to audit MySQL database access, and record user name, time and what was done — e.g. add/change/delete data, maybe reads too?

problem_statement: Small teams and solo developers running MySQL need lightweight, free, easy-to-deploy database access auditing (who did what, when) but existing solutions are either enterprise-priced, complex to configure, or lack a usable UI.
target_segment: Solo developers and small engineering teams (1-10 people) self-hosting MySQL for compliance or debugging purposes
notes: Recurring ask in the community. Existing tools (MySQL Enterprise Audit) are paid. A simple open-source or low-cost SaaS audit trail product could capture this segment.
